**1. Vikram ka asal iraada aur uske replies ka matlab:**

*   **Asal iraada:** Vikram asal mein emotional support aur empathy chahta tha. Usne 10 saal ki mehnat, pita ke retirement fund ka nuksan aur samajik apmaan jaisi bhari feeling ke saath message kiya tha. Woh ek dost chahta tha jo uske dukh ko sun aur samajh sake, na ki koi career counselor jo turant alternate options de.

    *   *"dus saal bhai"* - Umar aur mehnat ka barba hona.
    *   *"papa ka retirement fund delhi coaching mein gaya"* - Ghar ki financial stability barba karne ka gehra guilt.
    *   *"poori gali ab mazak mein collector sahab bulati hai"* - Apne hi mahaul mein apmaan (social humiliation) jhelna.
*   **Aakhri do replies ka matlab:** *"haan. shayad."* aur *"haan theek hai. chal baad mein baat karte hain."* yeh Vikram ka 'polite disengagement' (shaant tarike se baat katna) hai. Aman ki toxic positivity aur faltu advice se Vikram aur zyada akela feel kar raha hai. Woh Aman ki baaton se convince nahi hua, balki usko lag raha hai ki Aman uske dukh ki gehrai nahi samajh raha, isliye woh conversation ko rokna chahta hai.
